interpretation_boundaries: All initial-round attempts are retained, including local cancellation, network and protocol failures; no paid rerun was made for this review.
Complete SSE terminal is a transport observation; only completed/current publication establishes a usable account report.
First-byte, first SSE, first effective event and first text delta are different local timestamps; provider-side token timing has not been independently obtained.
Maximum idle is measured between effective progress events, including the initial wait and final interval; heartbeats do not renew it.
Sent effort and provider-reported effort remain separate; mismatch alone does not establish the failure cause.
Usage counters do not supply invoice prices; all cost-known flags are preserved and no accuracy or long-run success-rate claim is made.
Failed tasks have no result.agents: child completion statistics use durable events/checkpoints rather than treating missing final result as zero child reports.

failure_gap_analysis.conclusion: 本地在最后已观察网络字节和有效事件后约120秒触发流空闲保护；并非旧120秒绝对请求限，也没有证据表明最后间隙仍持续收到被忽略事件/心跳。停止交付字节的位置可能在供应商、网关/代理、链路等处，现有本地记录无法进一步归因。
